qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the plug for high pressure section of injection pump?
What screw type is used for the distributor injection pump to holder connection?
What is the torque value for the electric shutoff to injection pump?
How much torque should be applied to the electric cold start valve to injection pump?
What is the highest torque specification listed in this injection pump control receptacle table?
qa_pairs.answer: 45 Nm for the pressure valve holder to injection pump

qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the distributor injection pump to flange and console?
What is the lowest torque value specified in this table?
qa_pairs.answer: 2.5 Nm for the electrical line on fuel cutout device

qa_pairs.question: Which connections use the M21/M51/M41 screw type?
qa_pairs.answer: Plug for high pressure section, distributor injection pump to holder, electric shutoff to injection pump, coupling bolt (OUT) to injection pump, and distributor injection pump to flange and console
